name: pg_restrictive_usernames
abstract: Unicode username, nickname and label policy and confusable-skeleton keys for unique indexes
description: Validates usernames, nicknames and labels against the UTS #39 identifier profile with Highly Restrictive script mixing, refuses Zalgo stacks and compatibility look-alikes, and computes UTS #39 confusable skeletons, in stored and in UAX #9 display order, for unique expression indexes. Every function is IMMUTABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE. The same Rust library is usable from the application. Built with pgrx (cargo pgrx install).
